thread:
Evan: Quick thread to capture recurring incident patterns for the last 60 days and propose owners for fixes. Goal: reduce repeat pages by 60% next quarter.

PagerBot: Ingest complete 1 incidents found in 60d. Clusters: pool-saturation, deploy-misconfig, token-rotation, thirdparty-throttle. Summary: https://dash/reports/recurrence-60d

Tara: can you post counts? helps prioritize.

Evan: counts: pool-saturation 8, deploy-misconfig 6, token-rotation 4, thirdparty-throttle 3.

Maya: I'll take deploy-misconfig. Plan: add a CI guard for deployment labels + a post-deploy verification job. ETA: 3w.

Rob: happy to take pool-saturation. Short term: increase pool margin during model refresh windows; long term: autoscaler policy update + better KV cache reuse. ETA: 4w for short term.

Tara: token-rotation I'll own. I'll add an expiry-monitor + forced-refresh tool for stale tokens. ETA: 2w.

Evan: proposed actions: 
- ACTION-REC-01: Pool margin + autoscaler tweaks. Owner: Rob. ETA: 2026-04-18.
- ACTION-REC-02: Deploy CI guard + verifier. Owner: Maya. ETA: 2026-04-05.
- ACTION-REC-03: Token rotation monitor & forced refresh. Owner: Tara. ETA: 2026-03-28.
- ACTION-REC-04: Third-party throttle strategy (retries + quota). Owner: Evan. ETA: 2026-04-10.

PagerBot: Reminder: ACTIONs without owners after 48h escalate to oncall.

Maya: adding note 1: include a "recurrence root cause" field in every ticket so we track why it kept happening.

Rob: will post a draft alert rule and a short load-test plan by EOD.

Tara: requesting a 24h low-traffic window for token refresh integration tests. Evan can you authorize?

Evan: approved 24h window. I'll add to calendar and link tickets once created.

Rob: :thumbsup: starting prototyping pre-warm script.

Evan: thanks all. I'll open ENG tickets and update this thread with links. Scheduling a 20m follow-up next Tue to review PRs.
